## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, intended result, and scope. Identify legacy versus CMS impact.

## Validation and review

- [ ] Acceptance criteria and final source revision are identified.
- [ ] `npm run preflight` passed; actual evidence and limitations are summarized below.
- [ ] Exact staged/committed content, index/history secrets, and local-only files were reviewed.
- [ ] Applicable senior role self-reviews and independent QA/reviewer findings were resolved.
- [ ] The primary presented the current Chinese consolidated report to the user locally.
- [ ] The user explicitly authorized this upload/PR scope. No private report or secret is attached.
- [ ] Actual required GitHub CI is green for this revision before merge.

List executed checks, not-tested items, findings, and relevant source/run references.
Checkboxes are review records, not automatic proof of approval or execution.

## Release and recovery impact

State configuration, IAM, data/migration, compatibility, cost, and rollback effects.
Confirm whether deployment changes; disclose remaining production prerequisites.
PR authorization does not authorize merge, tag publication, deployment, or deletion.
